name: EtherVista pair invariant incident
summary: A researcher reports an Ethereum pool invariant check used arithmetic that could overflow, allowing withdrawals inconsistent with the intended reserve constraint. Reported loss is approximately USD 18,600; Hindsight has not validated the causal implementation.

primary_sources.summary: Researcher write-up links the candidate victim pair and transaction and reports Solidity 0.5.16 source.

coverage_gaps: Recover the exact incident-time pair and factory sources; independently check compiler settings, arithmetic widths and router authorization.
Chain, language, identifiers, historical implementation and economic impact are source-reported, not independently verified by Hindsight.
Source rights, earliest disclosure, exploit-family boundaries and human adjudication remain unresolved. No training or benchmark eligibility is established.
